decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's announced direction of binding mobile communication and trusted second-channel interactions, so the visible commitment and accumulated investment favour persisting with it despite modest website prominence.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture was promoted to its own page in 2019 and embodies the firm's central security positioning, making a drop a costly write-off and an admission of error.

The QR-code hardware signature token received a dedicated page and draws on the firm's hardware and signature investment, and any weak sales can still be attributed to temporary market conditions, so management keeps it.

The payment security compliance suite builds on established know-how and addresses regulatory demand, but it was only mentioned and never featured on its own page, so commitment is weaker and the risk of dropping it is higher, though not high enough to drop.
